Goldeen

Water

Kanto · Generation 1

Goldeen is a Water-type Goldfish Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 15 kg. It evolves into Seaking. Its highest base stat is Attack (67), with a base stat total of 320.
